instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Pivot a column to present values as columns
output: SELECT * FROM (SELECT cateredcol FROM ratings) src PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR cateredcol IN (1, 2, 3));

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Unpivot columns back to rows
output: SELECT * FROM ratings UNPIVOT (val FOR keycol IN (a, b, c));

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Use CASE to map a numeric to a label
output: SELECT *, CASE WHEN col > 100 THEN 'high' WHEN col > 50 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS bucket FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Extract a value from a JSON column
output: SELECT ratings.*, attrs ->> 'color' AS color FROM ratings WHERE attrs ->> 'color' = 'red';

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Full-text search against a text column
output: SELECT * FROM ratings WHERE to_tsvector('english', col) @@ to_tsquery('english', 'term');

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Regex find rows matching a pattern
output: SELECT * FROM ratings WHERE col ~ '^[A-Z]2[0-9]+$';

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Coalesce to replace null with a fallback
output: SELECT ratings.*, COALESCE(col, 'UNKNOWN') AS col_filled FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Prevent division by zero using NULLIF
output: SELECT ratings.*, price / NULLIF(discount, 0) AS effective FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Upsert with a single statement
output: INSERT INTO ratings (id, col) VALUES (1, 'x') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET col = EXCLUDED.col;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Self join to compare rows to their previous one
output: SELECT a.* FROM ratings a JOIN ratings b ON a.id = b.id + 1;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Recursive query expanding a tree
output: WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT id FROM ratings WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM ratings c JOIN t ON c.parent_id = t.id) SELECT * FROM t;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Grouped string aggregation combining text values
output: SELECT grp, STRING_AGG(col, ', ') FROM ratings GROUP BY grp;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Window rank used to select a top row
output: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY col DESC) rn FROM ratings) x WHERE rn = 1;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Date truncation to bucket into weeks
output: SELECT date_trunc('week', dt), COUNT(*) FROM ratings GROUP BY date_trunc('week', dt);

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
GREATEST/LEAST to clamp a value
output: SELECT *, GREATEST(col, 0) AS clamped FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Use EXTRACT to pull the year from a date
output: SELECT *, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt) AS yr FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Array unnest to flatten into rows
output: SELECT ratings.*, unnest(tags) AS tag FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Gaps-and-islands via window differences
output: SELECT *, SUM(new_grp) OVER (ORDER BY dt) AS grp FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(dt) OVER (ORDER BY dt) IS NULL OR dt - LAG(dt) OVER (ORDER BY dt) > INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_grp FROM ratings) x;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Condensation of a table into delimited string
output: SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT grp, '|') FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Compute a running percentile
output: SELECT col, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col) OVER () FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Backfill missing values with LAST_VALUE ignoring nulls
output: SELECT *, COALESCE(col, LAST_VALUE(col IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY dt)) FROM ratings;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Generate a date series joined to data
output: SELECT gs, COUNT(t.id) FROM generate_series('2024-01-01','2024-01-10','1 day') gs LEFT JOIN ratings t ON t.dt::date = gs GROUP BY gs;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Translate / pivot using FILTER clause
output: SELECT grp, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE col = 'x') AS xs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE col = 'y') AS ys FROM ratings GROUP BY grp;

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Multi-column UNPIVOT style via CROSS JOIN LATERAL
output: SELECT t.*, k.v FROM ratings t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('col1',col1),('col2',col2)) AS k(k,v);

instruction:
Schema: ratings(id, film_id, score, rated_on)
Window difference between partition first and current
output: SELECT *, col - FIRST_VALUE(col) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY dt) AS delta FROM ratings;
